description: Request a CDN+ cache purge (invalidation). Purge whole content or specific files/directory. isWholeDomain/isWholePurge select scope.

domainIdList.description: Domain IDs to purge (required when isWholeDomain=false)

isWholeDomain.description: true: purge across all domains; false: only domains in domainIdList

isWholePurge.description: true: purge all files; false: only targetFileList / targetDirectoryName

targetDirectoryName.description: Directory to purge — invalidates all files within (when isWholePurge=false)

targetFileList.description: Specific file paths to purge (when isWholePurge=false)

name: ncloud_cdnplus_request_purge
